criteria.description: A WhatsApp time-log message is parsed into structured fields; a non-time-log message is not misinterpreted as a log.
criteria.evidence: WP04 main recognizes the log-time shape + extracts fields (scripts/openclaw/agents/tests/test_timelog_prompt.py); WP03 returns not_timelog for non-time-log input (tests/google/test_timelog.py). Commits 78d38302, 3fbbaf01.
criteria.notes: Option A: main (LLM) extracts; the deterministic helper validates. No NL regex/LLM in the write path.

criteria.description: The named client resolves to its workbook tab via a normalizing client->tab map (tabs-as-truth + aliases).
criteria.evidence: WP03 timelog resolves client->tab via WP02 list-tabs + timelog-clients.json aliases (tests/google/test_timelog.py). Commit 3fbbaf01.
criteria.notes: Tabs are the source of truth; aliases bridge fuzzy names.

criteria.description: Unknown/ambiguous client -> do not write; ask to confirm or add; wait.
criteria.evidence: WP03 returns unknown_client/ambiguous with NO write; WP04 main asks (test_timelog + test_timelog_prompt). Commits 3fbbaf01, 78d38302.
criteria.notes: Fail-safe: nothing lands in the wrong tab.

criteria.description: On new-client confirm, create the tab then log; the two-step is non-atomic and a created-tab-with-failed-append is reported as not logged.
criteria.evidence: WP03 client_created_entry_failed on create-ok/append-fail (never 'logged'); WP02 create-tab no-op + append (tests/google/test_timelog.py + test_sheets_helper.py). Commits 3fbbaf01, 4c52201b.
criteria.notes: Codex CRITICAL finding F3 folded + tested.

criteria.description: Append exactly one row (date, hours, client, description, billable) + a logged-at timestamp + entry_id.
criteria.evidence: WP02 append-row (idempotent + read-back-confirmed) + WP03 row assembly (tests/google/test_sheets_helper.py + test_timelog.py). Commits 4c52201b, 3fbbaf01.
criteria.notes: Idempotency key (entry_id) + read-back before success (Codex F8).

criteria.description: Reply with a receipt matching what was written; correct/remove the most-recent entry on a follow-up.
criteria.evidence: WP03 corrected/deleted via the recent-write ledger; correction_ambiguous guards a newer write; WP04 relays the receipt (tests/google/test_timelog.py). Commit 3fbbaf01.
criteria.notes: Conversation-keyed ledger prevents cross-conversation mis-correction (Codex F4).

criteria.description: On any failure, no partial/wrong write; report truthfully; 'logged' gated on an API-confirmed append.
criteria.evidence: WP02 read-back-confirms before success; WP03 error (never false 'logged') + #701 alert; mutation-tested in both reviews (tests/google/test_sheets_helper.py + test_timelog.py). Commits 4c52201b, 3fbbaf01.
criteria.notes: The whole #683 dependency: never fabricate a 'logged'. Live SC-001..005 verified post-deploy at office2 (with the Sheets re-consent).
